youtube_description:
A lights-on ride through of Dinosaur, at Disney's Animal Kingdom. Recorded during the fall 2021 Disney College Program Celebration Event at Animal Kingdom. (Probably the best thing to come out of my program).

Yes, there are people talking during the ride. Yes, one of those people is me. No, I won't apologize for any of it.
